display_title: I Was Cheated on by My Soul
description:
Shin Na-young, acting manager of the quality control team of Yesung Group. Unlike her name, Nayoung's daily life is full of things that are not exciting.

The endless thrashing of people around me, the rising cost of congratulations, the appearance of an uncompromising lover...

"Yes, it's a non-marriage ceremony!"

Nayoung decided not to get married and while she was at it, she also held a non-wedding ceremony to recover the congratulatory expenses. And I move into a terrace house that will make my dream of non-marriage come true...…

"You were supposed to marry me."

I woke up in the morning dreaming of spending a sweet night with a handsome man. There was a real man next to him! That's also!

Hallelujah! No, no, who are you?!

Nayoung wanted to go crazy and jump, but the man handed out a contract.

I didn't hear anything like this when I signed up for a house! I don't know. Back off! This marriage is a fraud!
